responsibility: Implements the front end's compile-time arithmetic model on top of GMP and MPFR. It initializes target-kind precision and range tables, converts between MPFR/MPZ and Fortran scalar representations, and provides constant-evaluation helpers for numeric and character conversion routines that other parsing, simplification, and target-memory code use when folding expressions.
same_name_distinction: Implements the compile-time arithmetic subsystem itself: MPFR/GMP-backed model initialization, range/value handling, folding operations, and constant kind/type conversions. Unlike gcc/fortran/arith.h, this is the executable implementation rather than the declarations of that arithmetic API.
